school_name: North Carolina State University at Raleigh
title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten named destinations on Hillsborough Street and nearby connecting corridors, each with one source-backed reason to stop.

cards.title: Hillsborough Street for free art
cards.subtitle: Hillsborough Street corridor — 1903 Hillsborough Street
cards.notes: Check the current exhibitions, then use the museum’s public hours to plan a self-guided visit; admission is listed as free.
cards.short_summary: A public art museum at the Hillsborough Street edge of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gregg Museum is at 1903 Hillsborough Street, is open to the public, and has free admission.
cards.source_title: Visit | Gregg Museum of Art + Design
cards.access_notes: Public hours are Tuesday–Saturday, 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; confirm special closures before going.

cards.title: Ashe Avenue for park time
cards.subtitle: Ashe Avenue beside the Hillsborough Street corridor — 520 Ashe Avenue
cards.notes: Use the city’s park map to choose a playground, court, field, arts, or theatre stop; rides require separate tickets.
cards.short_summary: A City of Raleigh park with recreation areas and optional amusement rides.
cards.evidence_claim: Pullen Park is at 520 Ashe Avenue and offers playgrounds, courts and fields, arts, theatre, and ticketed rides.
cards.access_notes: The park and restrooms are listed open daily 7 a.m.–9 p.m.; ride availability varies.

cards.title: Hillsborough Street for coffee and biscuits
cards.subtitle: Hillsborough Street corridor — 2100 Hillsborough Street, Suite 100
cards.notes: Use the posted Hillsborough location and menu to plan a coffee, sweet biscuit, waffle, or sandwich stop.
cards.short_summary: A café at the Belltower end of Hillsborough Street with coffee and food.
cards.evidence_claim: Jubala lists its NCSU Belltower location at 2100 Hillsborough Street and offers coffee, biscuits, waffles, and sandwiches.
cards.access_notes: Listed Hillsborough hours are 7 a.m.–5 p.m. weekdays and 8 a.m.–5 p.m. weekends.

cards.title: Hillsborough Street for organic coffee
cards.subtitle: Hillsborough Street corridor — 2428 Hillsborough Street
cards.notes: Use the address to find the café and check its current offerings directly before visiting; the corridor directory lists it as a coffee shop.
cards.short_summary: A named coffee-shop stop along Hillsborough Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hillsborough Street corridor directory lists Global Village Organic Coffee at 2428 Hillsborough Street under coffee shops.
cards.access_notes: Check the business directly for current operating details.

cards.title: Hillsborough Street for warm cookies
cards.subtitle: Hillsborough Street corridor — 2302 Hillsborough Street, Suite 104
cards.notes: Use the shop’s listed address for a cookie stop, and check its menu or ordering options before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A Hillsborough Street cookie shop listed with freshly baked cookie flavors.
cards.evidence_claim: Insomnia Cookies is listed at 2302 Hillsborough Street and offers freshly baked cookies in multiple flavors.
cards.access_notes: The corridor listing shows daily hours of 11 a.m.–3 a.m.; verify before a late visit.

cards.title: Hillsborough Street for arepas
cards.subtitle: Hillsborough Street corridor — 2524 Hillsborough Street
cards.notes: Use the listed address for a quick food stop and review the restaurant’s current menu before choosing what to order.
cards.short_summary: A named fast-casual food stop on Hillsborough Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hillsborough Street corridor directory lists Guasaca at 2524 Hillsborough Street in its food-on-the-go category.
cards.source_title: Food on the Go | Hillsborough Street
cards.access_notes: Check the restaurant directly for current hours and menu availability.

cards.title: Hillsborough Street for essentials
cards.subtitle: Hillsborough Street corridor — 2512 Hillsborough Street
cards.notes: Use the corridor listing to locate the store when you need everyday items, then check Target directly for in-stock products.
cards.short_summary: A named retail destination on the Hillsborough Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hillsborough Street directory lists Target at 2512 Hillsborough Street.
cards.access_notes: Check the retailer directly for current store details and product availability.

cards.title: Hillsborough Street for books and records
cards.subtitle: Hillsborough Street corridor — 3106 Hillsborough Street
cards.notes: Browse the physical store’s used books and records, or ask about special orders; its site notes a rear lot reached from Daisy Street.
cards.short_summary: A single-location Raleigh book and record store on Hillsborough Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Nice Price Books & Records lists its one Raleigh location at 3106 Hillsborough Street and sells used books and records.
cards.access_notes: Its site lists daily hours of 11 a.m.–7 p.m.; check for holiday changes.

cards.title: Hillsborough Street for an early coffee stop
cards.subtitle: Hillsborough Street corridor — 3100 Hillsborough Street
cards.notes: Use the Hillsborough location for coffee and check the café’s posted daily hours before starting an early errand or study break.
cards.short_summary: A coffee-shop location with daily hours beginning at 6 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Cup A Joe lists its Hillsborough Street location at 3100 Hillsborough Street and daily hours of 6 a.m.–7 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Listed as open seven days a week, 6 a.m.–7 p.m.; verify changes directly.

cards.title: Beryl Road for a free garden walk
cards.subtitle: Beryl Road corridor, near Hillsborough Street — 4415 Beryl Road
cards.notes: Enter during the posted garden hours and explore the living plant collection; review event notices because special programs can affect access.
cards.short_summary: A public NC State garden and living laboratory with no admission charge.
cards.evidence_claim: The JC Raulston Arboretum is at 4415 Beryl Road, open to the public year-round, and has free admission.
cards.access_notes: Garden hours vary seasonally; the official visitor page notes occasional event-related schedule changes.
